questions.stem: What is the function of the oesophagus in the digestive system?

options.text: To produce bile for fat digestion
To chemically digest food using enzymes
To absorb nutrients into the blood
To transport food from the mouth to the stomach by peristalsis

questions.explanation: The oesophagus is a muscular tube that moves food from the mouth to the stomach using wave-like muscle contractions called peristalsis.
